The focus report, the pericope's self-assessed craft, lost striving, and absent weight form a distinct public-report mechanism. Every supplied branch is landed, and the report-centered change is not an exact duplicate of the broader craft-and-measure finding.

findings.title: Misjudged craft fails the final measure
findings.claim: The pericope turns the announced greatest loss into a reversal of self-assessed workmanship: purposeful effort that is supposed good and skillfully made can still be lost, rejected, and found without standing when the works meet an external measure.
findings.mechanism: The focus loss and work carriers meet supposition, striving, good action, making, lost course, rejection, valuation, and weight in 18:104-105. Their contact moves the reading from the amount of activity to the mismatch between self-estimate, direction, and assessed value.
findings.reader_payoff: The question becomes newly legible as a warning that visible effort and confident craftsmanship do not by themselves establish the value of what has been made.
findings.containment: The ordinary question about the greatest losers remains intact. The failed-exchange branch is a contextual portfolio analogy, not a literal marketplace scene, and the finding does not claim that every craft or every loss has one cause.

epistemic.reason: The trusted channel supplies the complete branch nomination and pericope supports; the integrated relation is a bounded contextual synthesis.

branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus loss and the adjacent good-action and making occurrences supply the discrepancy that the estimate fails to see.
branch_activations.activation: Supposition meets the focus loss and the good-making description, so self-approval becomes part of the mechanism by which effort is misvalued.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The loss is not only an external verdict; it is a failure of the actor's own reckoning to register the result.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch supplies a bounded supposition relation and does not make every use of reckoning a literal ledger.

branch_activations.boundary: The relation does not say that the ordinary good-action meaning is false or that skill is itself blameworthy.

findings.containment: The report remains ordinary disclosure, and the craft and scale images remain contextual resonances. The finding does not claim that the report is a separate revelation channel or that all skill is deceptive.
